title: Expanding the submillimeter wave spectroscopy and astronomical search for thioacetamide (CH<SUB>3</SUB>CSNH<SUB>2</SUB>) in the ISM
question: To expand the measured rotational spectrum of thioacetamide (CH3CSNH2) from 150 to 650 GHz and use these measurements to search for this species and constrain its abundance and formation pathways in the ISM.

data.bands: Band 3 (84.1 to 114.4 GHz for EMoCA), Bands 4 and 7 (for NGC 6334I)

what.value: Rotational spectrum measurements of thioacetamide in the 59.6-110.0 GHz region (286 v_t=0 lines)

evidence.quote: Its rotational spectrum was recorded recently by free-jet absorption spectroscopy in the 59.6–110.0 GHz frequency region (cite: 2019ECS.....3.1537M).
The final data set contains both the data from the previous study (cite: 2019ECS.....3.1537M), and new assignments in the millimeter- and submillimeter wave ranges.

evidence.quote: It has nonzero dipole components along the $a$- ($\mu_a$ = 4.1 D) and $b$-axes ($\mu_b$ = -1.1 D) as determined by (cite: Sundaresa1957).

evidence.quote: The parameters for methanol, methyl mercaptan, and acetamide were taken from (cite: 2016A&A...587A..92M) and (cite: 2017A&A...601A..49B).

evidence.quote: Table notes: rest frequencies from (cite: 2004JMoSp.227..140I) and F. J. Lovas, private communication.

recipe.goal: Measure and fit the laboratory rotational spectrum of thioacetamide and compute partition functions
recipe.method: Record absorption spectrum from 150 to 650 GHz with the Lille fast-scanning THz spectrometer, fit transitions together with literature 59.6-110 GHz lines using the rho-axis-method (RAM) Hamiltonian in RAM36, and compute rotational-torsional and vibrational partition functions using ab initio harmonic frequencies from Gaussian 09.
key_parameters: Frequency range 150 to 650 GHz, sample pressure ~15 Pa at room temperature, 40 RAM Hamiltonian parameters, 2035 lines fitted (v_t=0 and v_t=1)
assumptions: Dipole moment components mu_a = 4.1 D and mu_b = -1.1 D; harmonic approximation for lowest 7 vibrational modes (modes 2 to 8) below 1000 cm^-1

recipe.goal: Search for thioacetamide and derive column density upper limit toward Sgr B2(N2) using ALMA EMoCA data
recipe.method: Model the observed ALMA EMoCA spectrum at the peak of Sgr B2(N2) under LTE using WEEDS, adding contributions of previously modeled molecules and deriving a column density upper limit for CH3CSNH2.
key_parameters: Source size = 0.9'', T_rot = 180 K, line width Delta V = 5.0 km s^-1, velocity offset V_off = 1.5 km s^-1 (with respect to v_sys = 74 km s^-1), F_vib = 1.20
assumptions: LTE assumption justified by high density (>1x10^7 cm^-3); CH3CSNH2 assumed to trace the same region with fixed size, temperature, line width, and velocity offset as derived for CH3CONH2

recipe.goal: Model acetamide transitions and search for thioacetamide toward Sgr B2(N) LMH using GBT PRIMOS data
recipe.method: Model A- and E-state transitions of CH3CONH2 (including HFS below 18 GHz) and simulate CH3CSNH2 spectra between 8 and 24 GHz in the PRIMOS survey using MOLSIM with a single excitation temperature LTE model and non-thermal background.
key_parameters: T_ex = 5.8 K, source size = 20'', velocity components at +62, +71, and +81 km s^-1 (for CH3CONH2); line width = 20 km s^-1 (for CH3CSNH2)
assumptions: Single excitation temperature (5.8 K), thermalized transitions, optical depth correction, and non-thermal background continuum emission

recipe.goal: Search for thioacetamide and derive column density upper limit toward NGC 6334I using ALMA Bands 4 and 7 data
recipe.method: Generate synthetic LTE spectrum of CH3CSNH2 and compare against 3-sigma rms noise levels in ALMA Bands 4 and 7 spectra of NGC 6334I.
assumptions: LTE excitation at T_ex = 135 K matching the best-fit temperature of CH3CONH2 in NGC 6334I

recipe.goal: Search for thioacetamide and acetamide in ASAI sources with the IRAM 30m telescope
recipe.method: Generate synthetic LTE spectra using MOLSIM for 8 ASAI sources and derive 3-sigma column density upper limits using the transition that provides the most rigorous constraint (highest expected S/N).
key_parameters: T_bg = 2.7 K; source-specific Delta V (0.5 to 8.0 km s^-1), 3-sigma rms T_b (4.2 to 23.3 mK), and T_ex (10 to 80 K) as listed in Table 7; source size = 0.3'' for SVS13A
assumptions: LTE excitation; source fills the IRAM 30m beam for all targets except SVS13A (0.3''); background temperature of 2.7 K

recipe.goal: Evaluate gas-phase formation pathways of thioacetamide via quantum chemical calculations
recipe.method: Optimize geometries and find transition states and intermediates for four proposed neutral-neutral gas-phase reactions using DFT (B3LYP/6-311G++(d,p)), confirm transition states with internal reaction coordinate (IRC) analysis, and refine energies with CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVTZ single point calculations in Gaussian 16.
key_parameters: B3LYP/6-311G++(d,p) for geometry optimization and free energy corrections at T = 15 K; CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVTZ for single point energies
assumptions: Temperature of 15 K for free energy corrections; analogous reaction paths to those studied for acetamide by Foo et al. (2018)

evidence.quote: A total of 1428 transitions from the v$_t$=0 state with maximum values J=47 and K$_a$=20 in the range up to 330 GHz, and J=95 and K$_a$=20 in the range from 400–660 GHz were assigned.

answer_key.quantity: Assigned v_t = 1 rotational transitions of CH3CSNH2

evidence.quote: We also assigned 321 transitions from the v$_t$=1 state with the maximum values J=35 and K$_a$=9 up to 330 GHz.

answer_key.quantity: RMS deviation of final RAM Hamiltonian fit (2035 lines)

evidence.quote: We achieved a final fit with a root-mean-square deviation of 43.4 kHz that contains 2035 measured lines from our study and the literature for v$_t$=0 and v$_t$=1 states of A and E symmetries.
